title: Bushnell Tour V5 SHIFT range finder - Product review
description:
The Bushnell Tour V5 SHIFT golf range finder is designed to help improve players accuracy of pin positions or hazards whilst they are playing golf.

This range finder is designed to;
Size, speed & accuracy evolved in this new generation of tech.
Pinseeker technology with visual jolt & red ring around eyepiece when laser locked on.
BITE magnetic mount - 7lbs magnetic force.
Next level clarity and brightness especially if the weather conditions are lightly darker or hazier than normal.
6 x zoom by rotating the eye piece bezel.
Patented slope compensation that will change your game.
Slope switch technology lets the golfer easily switch the Tour V5 shift in & out of SLOPE mode making the Tour V5 shift legal during tournament play when slope is disabled.
Is used by 99.3% of PGA tour pros.

The size of the range finder is, Length; 4.5'', Width; 1.5'', Height; 3'', Weight; 8oz
Not waterproof
Display is LCD

Range is; 5-1300 yards with an accuracy of 1 yard and with a field of view at 330ft @ 1000 yards

2 year limited manufacturers warranty

This range finder on Bushnell's own website got a 4.5 out of 5 star rating within its 294 reviews, in my opinion it does exactly what it is designed to do. It is well engineered and durable to last a long time so I will give it 5 stars, but would like if possible if it could be waterproof in the next generation for players that do not just play golf in sunny climates
